figures.title: Durable identity binding
figures.description: Repository/worktree links to host process, managed session and destination. Attribution is not permission and does not require transcript collection.
figures.review: Small historical connector labels extend across node-edge areas but remain readable; no node text is obscured. Source geometry intentionally retained.

figures.title: Managed-session lifecycle
figures.description: Owner-gated launch and verified binding precede active work; external sessions are observation-only and grant no control.
figures.review: Labels, lower external-session branch and caption readable; no clipping.

figures.title: Reaction, approval and execution
figures.description: A reaction leads to actor verification, scoped authority, reviewable plan and only the authorized effect. Feedback itself grants no authority.
figures.review: All five nodes and three qualification labels readable.

figures.title: Reviewed golden-data provenance
figures.description: Approved examples are reviewed/redacted, grouped and deduplicated before a locked train/validation/held-out split. Held-out data never guides optimization.
figures.review: Branches terminate in distinct labelled splits; caption and explanation on same page.

figures.title: Experiment and deployment control planes
figures.description: A bounded experiment yields versioned evidence. A distinct human approval and reviewed release path separates evidence from deployment authority.
figures.review: Both proposed planes explicitly labelled; dashed path and caption readable.

figures.title: Manually placed compute constellation
figures.description: A human places apps on three hypothetical hosts; a refinery candidate remains a separate future layer. This is not an observed fleet topology.
figures.review: All branches and optional-development note readable; no uptime claim.

figures.title: Versioned provenance chain
figures.description: Approved source, redaction, dataset version, candidate artifact and promotion record retain separate evidence, split and rollback bindings.
figures.review: Five stages and below-line labels readable.

figures.title: Observation versus failure
figures.description: An observation ages into unknown state until a verified check; missing updates do not establish failure or permission to act.
figures.review: Timeline labels distinguish observed, aging and unknown; time is qualitative, not measured.

accessibility.contrast: dark text on pale backgrounds visually reviewed; quantitative WCAG conformance not asserted
accessibility.color: labels and solid/dashed patterns convey distinctions without color alone
